config.notes: Frozen before further representation optimizations. Supplements, never replaces, workloads.json. Affine chains deliberately materialize shared prefixes in the current ISA, exposing physical expansion. History has at most two live facts. Branch workloads execute local Cases. Real cases include actual integer branch and Plotkin theorem proofs; their immutable requested contracts are retained. Each observation is a fresh process after preparation; nine samples and separate RSS observations. Unsupported future theorem families must be added as a separately versioned matrix, not silently substituted.
